title: Everyday Products and Their Functions
summary: Describing products, functions, qualities, and recommendations.
whyItMatters: Product language helps compare practical needs, understand instructions, and explain whether an object is suitable, reliable, efficient, or repairable.

mentalModel.title: Need before feature
mentalModel.content: Define the user's problem before evaluating product specifications.

mentalModel.title: Feature, function, benefit
mentalModel.content: Connect what a product has, what it does, and why that matters.

ruleBlocks.title: Name parts and controls
ruleBlocks.content: Use Gerät, Gehäuse, Taste, Anschluss, Akku, Behälter, and display precisely.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect features to functions
ruleBlocks.content: Explain with dienen zu, ermöglichen, sich eignen für, and damit kann man.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate relevant qualities
ruleBlocks.content: Compare durability, energy use, ease of use, safety, price, and repairability.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe operation and maintenance
ruleBlocks.content: State setup, use, cleaning, charging, storage, and common faults.

sentenceStructure: Introduce the product and intended user.
Distinguish observed performance from advertising claims.

comparisons.summary: Relative clauses connect products to users, purposes, and prepositional relationships.
The communication lesson turns specifications into explanations and recommendations.

examples.de: Das Gerät hat einen Akku, der bis zu acht Stunden hält.
examples.en: The device has a battery that lasts up to eight hours.

examples.de: Der Behälter dient dazu, Flüssigkeiten sicher zu transportieren.
examples.en: The container serves to transport liquids safely.

examples.de: Mit der seitlichen Taste kann man die Temperatur einstellen.
examples.en: The side button can be used to set the temperature.

examples.de: Das Modell ist leicht, aber weniger robust als die größere Version.
examples.en: The model is light but less robust than the larger version.

examples.de: Ein Produkt, dessen Teile austauschbar sind, lässt sich länger nutzen.
examples.en: A product whose parts are replaceable can be used longer.

commonMistakes.correct: Connect each relevant feature to function and user need.
commonMistakes.reason: Specifications alone do not establish suitability.

commonMistakes.wrong: Call one product the best for everyone.
commonMistakes.correct: State the criteria and target user.

commonMistakes.wrong: Describe steps in an unclear order.
commonMistakes.correct: Use numbered sequence and precise controls.

tips: Choose three criteria before comparing products.
Explain one product without naming it.
Include maintenance and repair in evaluations.
